messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: realtime-serving latency anomaly detected. metric=latency.realtime.p95 10m=420ms (baseline 180ms), p99=1.5s. streaming tailups + increased stalls. dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dash/latency?panel=realtime
Maya K: Saw the alert — paging @Sahil @Lee for triage. Opening live mitigation bridge.
Sahil R: Oncall ack. Starting quick checks: infra, queue backlog, recent deploys, model kv cache.
Lee C: Will look at node and pod metrics.
Infra Bot: Created INC-2026 and sent page to oncall rotation.
Maya K: @Anika please check customer-facing impact while we triage.
Anika P: Checking CS/ops — early signal: payment-ingest pipeline shows ~5% timeouts for 02:18-02:22 UTC, some streaming sessions dropped. Notifying top customers.
Sahil R: Running quick commands: `kubectl get pods -n rwd-serving -o wide` and `rwd-metrics query "kv_cache_miss_rate{env=\"prod\"}" --window=10m`
Sahil R: Paste outputs:
```
POD                          READY   STATUS    CPU%   MEM%   NODE
model-serving-v3-7f9b6       2/2     Running   62     78     gpu-7
model-facing-proxy-2        3/3     Running   35     40     k8s-12
```
kv_cache_miss_rate prod 10m: 2% -> 28% (spike correlated with v3 rollout at 02:16 UTC)
Lee C: gpu-7 mem at 92% — likely kv-cache policy change increased memory pressure and caused cache churn -> tail latency.
Sahil R: Recent change: model-serving:v3 introduced aggressive prefix eviction policy. That explains large miss rate increase and streaming stalls.
Maya K: Decision: rollback model-serving to v2 while we stabilize. @Infra Bot initiate rollback and enable burst capacity.
Infra Bot: rollback job started: `deploy rollback model-serving --to v2 --namespace rwd-serving` (ETA ~4m). Enabling transient burst pool +25% capacity.
Sahil R: While rollback runs, shift 25% traffic to dedicated-pool-us-east as fallback: `rwd route shift --to dedicated-pool-us-east --percent 25`
Lee C: Route shift applied. Also bumping replicas for proxy layer by +2 to absorb connection spikes.
Maya K: Live bridge: Maya (incident lead), Sahil (primary), Lee (infra). @Anika handle comms. 15-min watch.
Anika P: Status update posted to status.redwood.ai: "Investigating increased inference latency and streaming session drops in US-EAST; mitigation in progress." CS emailed top-3 affected customers.
Sahil R: KV warmup queued for v2 after rollback to avoid cold misses: `kv-warmup --model v2 --region us-east --concurrency 8`
Infra Bot: Rollback completed at +3m52s :white_check_mark:
Lee C: Observability after rollback: p95=210ms, p99=400ms, streaming stall rate down ~80%. Error/timeouts trending back to baseline.
Sahil R: Confirming metrics: GPU mem freed, kv_cache_miss_rate back to ~3%. No pod evictions.
Maya K: Great. Continue 30m monitoring. We'll keep bridge open for now. Handoff: Sahil remains primary for next 30m, Lee covers infra oncall.
Sahil R: Follow-ups noted: root cause = aggressive kv eviction change in v3. Action items: add pre-rollout kv-cache smoke test; ensure canary warms KV for 15m; add streaming-tail p99 surge alert rule.
Lee C: I'll implement infra-side guardrails (max eviction threshold, memory safety check on rollout) and add a k8s resource quota to prevent OOM from cache churn.
Anika P: Customer comms draft ready for top customers; will send an update once we hit stable metrics for 30m.
Maya K: Filing postmortem ticket and assigning action owners: Sahil -> alert tuning and canary smoke tests; Lee -> infra guardrails & deploy gate; Anika -> customer follow-up.
Customer Ops: Thanks for the quick mitigation. Please include impacted timeframe and affected regions in the postmortem.
Maya K: Will do. Closing immediate mitigation — putting incident into watch mode for 30m. If p99 creeps above 700ms we re-open and page. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Sahil R: Monitoring dashboards and traces. Logging note for postmortem: sample traces show KV miss hotpath and backend retry cascades causing tail spikes.
Maya K: Thanks team — good triage and rollback. I'll write a short incident summary and add required follow-ups. Bridge clear in 10. :white_check_mark:
